from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The procedural role (e.g., 上诉人，被上诉人，复议申请人)")

class FeeAllocation(BaseModel):
    """A specific allocation of court fees or costs."""
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the cost")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount in currency string (e.g. '50 元')")
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., 二审受理费，一审案件受理费)")

class MonetaryAdjustment(BaseModel):
    """A specific monetary adjustment, compensation, or award mentioned."""
    description: str | None = Field(description="What the money is for (e.g., 补偿款，还款本金)")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount in currency string")

class DocumentFingerprint(BaseModel):
    """A structured representation of one judgment document."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The official case number (e.g., (2022) 粤 03 执异 655 号)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court issuing the ruling")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The procedural type (e.g., 二审民事判决，执行异议复议裁定)")
    verdict_summary: str | None = Field(description="The core ruling outcome (e.g., 驳回上诉，维持原判)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved")
    fee_allocations: list[FeeAllocation] = Field(description="Details on who pays which fees")
    monetary_adjustments: list[MonetaryAdjustment] = Field(description="Specific amounts awarded or changed")
    quote_anchor: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt capturing the key outcome")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentFingerprint]
